description: GraphQL-style index over all Life Coach session logs. Each entry references a daily log file and carries structured metadata for querying patterns across time.

fields.session_count: Int (number of messages logged that day)
fields.mood_arc: String (how mood shifted across the day)
fields.goals_touched: [String] — health | wealth | hobbies | social | spiritual | vision
fields.insights: [String] — therapist observations about patterns, breakthroughs, regressions
fields.flags: [String] — anything urgent to revisit next session

MessageEntry.description: One entry per PJ message inside a daily log file

fields.therapist_note: String — what a good therapist would write down from this message

queries.getRange: Read multiple daily files between two dates
queries.searchTheme: Grep logs/ for a theme keyword
queries.getHabitTrend: Read index.json entries[] and extract habits field across dates
queries.getFlags: Scan entries[] for non-empty flags fields
queries.getMoodArc: Read entries[].mood_arc across a date range
